description: Backend tests that ALREADY fail on main (commit 31c1475) with the same Node 22 / UTC / no-frontend-node_modules environment CI uses. Reproduced on both main and the PR branch; none was introduced by the security remediation. The CI gate (backend/scripts/ci-regression-gate.js) fails on ANY failing test that is not listed here, so a new regression still turns CI red. Remove an entry as soon as its test is fixed.
